_readme: Per-item limits for tools/visual_checks.py (its DEFAULTS cover the rest). Sections: views (by tools/screenshots.gd name), people (phase/name from tools/scene_probe.gd), props (the probe's name). A 'known' entry records a measured fault tolerated at today's value so the check still catches it getting worse: fix it, then delete the entry.

street/porch_loafer.known: shirt outside the coat by ~1 cm (max 3) at 14% of the shirt near it, along the sleeve seams and at the coat's open front at the waist (2026-10-05). Where the coat's surface turns or ends the measure is weakest, so not confirmed by eye; the same on every BodyMesh man in a coat (characters session: body_mesh.gd).

saloon/seated_man.known: the stranger's left sole 11 cm under the saloon floor in sit_lean (2026-10-05): below the frame in the saloon shot, but wrong. The seat and pose are ShotMatch's (SEAT, pose offsets: art), his legs the fit's (characters).

street/kid.known: the Kid's hair under his hat's brim at the sides, outside its edge, at 39% of the head's vertices near the hat (2026-10-05): by eye the hat perches high and nothing comes through the crown; the hat piece's size and seat are the characters session's (fit_tripo.py CROWN_SHARE, HAT_BAND).
